name: linkedin-mcp-server
description: Connect Claude to LinkedIn for profiles, connection requests, companies, job details, and people search
long_description:
# LinkedIn MCP Server

Connect Claude to your LinkedIn account with an MCP Bundle (MCPB, formerly DXT). The bundle starts quickly, downloads the Patchright Chromium browser in the background when needed, and opens LinkedIn login on the first auth-requiring tool call.

## First-time managed runtime flow

1. Install the `.mcpb` bundle in Claude Desktop.
2. Start Claude Desktop; the MCP server starts and begins preparing the Patchright Chromium browser cache under `~/.linkedin-mcp/patchright-browsers`.
3. If you call a tool before setup finishes, the tool returns a setup-in-progress error.
4. On the first tool call that needs authentication, a browser window opens so you can sign into LinkedIn.
5. Retry the tool after login completes.

Docker remains available as a separate runtime path, but it still requires host-side `--login`.

tools.name: get_person_profile
tools.description: Get detailed information from a LinkedIn profile including work history, education, certifications, skills, projects, connections, and recent posts

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's own LinkedIn profile with optional section selection (experience, education, skills, etc.)

tools.name: connect_with_person
tools.description: Send a connection request or accept an incoming one, with optional note

tools.name: get_sidebar_profiles
tools.description: Extract profile URLs from LinkedIn sidebar recommendation sections on a profile page

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Extract comprehensive company information and details. About-section references may include a company_urn entry carrying the numeric id LinkedIn's people-search uses in its currentCompany URL facet.

tools.name: get_company_posts
tools.description: Get recent posts from a company's LinkedIn feed

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search for companies on LinkedIn by keywords

tools.name: get_company_employees
tools.description: List employees at a company from the LinkedIn /people/ page, with optional keyword filter by name, title, or skill

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description: Retrieve specific job posting details using LinkedIn job IDs

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search for jobs with filters like keywords and location

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Search for people on LinkedIn by keywords, location, connection degree (1st/2nd/3rd), and current company

tools.name: get_inbox
tools.description: List recent conversations from the LinkedIn messaging inbox

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Read a specific messaging conversation by thread ID or LinkedIn username

tools.name: search_conversations
tools.description: Search LinkedIn messages by keyword

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a LinkedIn user with explicit confirmation and optional profile URN support

tools.name: get_feed
tools.description: Get recent posts from the authenticated user's LinkedIn home feed

tools.name: close_session
tools.description: Properly close browser session and clean up resources

tools.name: search
tools.description: ChatGPT-compatible read-only search across LinkedIn people, companies, and jobs

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: ChatGPT-compatible read-only fetch for a LinkedIn result id returned by search

tools.name: research_lead
tools.description: Collect LinkedIn person and optional company context into a draft-first sales outreach brief

tools.name: draft_outreach_message
tools.description: Draft a LinkedIn outreach message and connection note without sending

tools.name: plan_follow_up
tools.description: Create a draft-only follow-up schedule and message sequence

tools.name: review_outreach_target
tools.description: Review outreach context and copy for fit, specificity, and spam-risk signals
